anchor_definition: The anchor is the login request param-builder _ (the answer recorded in 1.json): a regenerator function whose body assembles the account-login params object and binds the password hash into it — hash: v()(i.password).toUpperCase(), i.e. uppercase MD5 of the password. The bundle is string-array obfuscated (field names via Qe([...])). The md5 routine is reached through a webpack module-interop reference (v()(...)); its implementation lives in a separate chunk (cross-file), so there is no same-file md5 function to award as a core utility, and a cross-file md5 submission scores 0 by policy. This param-builder is the in-file function that binds the observed hash value. The Qe string-decoder is a deobfuscation helper, not the answer.

anchor.why: _ = function(){...}: the regenerator that assembles the account-login request params; its case-0 builds the params object including hash: v()(i.password).toUpperCase(), i.e. the observed uppercase MD5 password hash bound to the request. This is the complete _ function recorded as the 1.json answer (the inner regenerator callback holding the hash line is contained within it).

roles.why: The string-array decoder used to obfuscate property names (e.g. Qe([101,108,126,101]) -> 'hash'); a deobfuscation helper, not the password-hash constructor. A sibling decoy.
